Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.","

The Nexx XR3R Zero Pro 2 helmet is a pinnacle of sporty design, blending aggressive aesthetics with functional prowess. The helmet offers an aerodynamic and featherlight 3k carbon shell that actively cuts through the air, enhancing aerodynamics while also cooling the interior. Featuring a race-inspired spoiler, it ensures added stability during high-speed rides. The interior is lined with X-MART Dry fabric, which not only cools by drying quickly but has a plush feel. Chin-area vortex generators address aerodynamic drag, while a double rubber seal around the visor and an anti-vibration visor plate contribute to a quieter riding experience, allowing you to concentrate on the journey ahead.

Limited-release ""Glaze Edition"" helmets are a Comoto exclusive. Glaze Edition helmets are produced in collaboration with Nexx and Comoto's in-house product design team. The Glaze Edition spec begins with a X-PRO 3k carbon composite shell that Nexx enhances with a one-of-a-kind Crystal Carbon finish. Logos and detailing are executed in Ice Blue, highlighting the ""cool"" Glaze Edition modus even further. A Blue Iridium face shield crowns the look - included in the box along with a standard, clear face shield.
• Limited edition Glaze Edition X-PRO 3k carbon composite shell with grey Crystal Carbon finish
• Race-style spoiler extension keeps helmet stable at high speeds
• Clear PC LEXAN anti-scratch face shield and second, Blue Iridium face shield included
• X-Sensus Vision face shield features 225° horizontal and 85° vertical fields
Pinlock and tear-off ready (Pinlock lens included, tear-offs sold separately)
• Double visor block system prevents unexpected opening of the visor
• Anti-vibration rubber visor plate minimizes visor disturbance
• Visor recoil system uses spring-loaded base side plates for an airtight seal
• Adjustable chin vent channel directs fresh air across the visor and face
• Crown pad has alveolar mesh that creates an air circulation chamber between EPS liner and padding
• Adaptive crown system is adjustable for a comfy fit
• Cheek pads can be fine tuned for fit
• X-MART dry fabrics are moisture-wicking and soft
• DOT and ECE 22.06 certified
• Emergency strap V2 system allows for easy access to medical personnel in case of an accident
Double D-ring and X-LOCK magnetic button fastening
